translations.literal: Thereupon he ordered Central Secretariat Director Zhang Yue, Right Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Xu Jian, Court of Imperial Sacrifices Vice Director Wei Tao, Secretariat Vice Director Kang Ziyuan, and National University Erudite Hou Xingguo, together with ritual officials at the Jixian Academy to compile regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Zhang Yue, Xu Jian, Wei Tao, Kang Ziyuan, Hou Xingguo, and ritual officials at Jixian Academy to compile regulations.

sentences.zh: 玄宗初以靈山好靜，不欲喧繁，與宰臣及侍講學士對議，用山下封祀之儀。

translations.literal: Xuanzong at first, because the spirit mountain favored quiet and he did not wish clamor, debated with chief ministers and lecturing scholars and used the feng-sacrifice rites below the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong, favoring the mountain's quiet, debated with ministers and used feng-sacrifice below.

sentences.zh: 於是張說謂徐堅、韋絛等曰：「乾封舊儀，禪社首，享皇地祇，以先後配饗。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhang Yue told Xu Jian, Wei Tao, and others: "Qianfeng old rites: shan at Sheshou, offering to Imperial Earth Sovereign, with former empresses as matched offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue told Xu Jian and Wei Tao, "Qianfeng old rites: shan at Sheshou to Earth Sovereign with empresses matched.

sentences.zh: 王者父天而母地，當今皇母位，亦當往帝之母也，子配母饗，亦有何嫌？

translations.literal: The king fathers Heaven and mothers Earth; the present imperial mother's position is also the position of past emperors' mothers—son matching mother in offering, what suspicion is there?
translations.idiomatic: The king fathers Heaven and mothers Earth; today's imperial mother is past emperors' mothers—son matching mother, what suspicion?

sentences.zh: 而以皇后配地祇，非古之制也。

translations.literal: Yet matching the empress to Earth Sovereign is not ancient form.
translations.idiomatic: Yet matching empress to Earth Sovereign is not ancient.

sentences.zh: 天監孔明，福善如響。

translations.literal: Heaven's scrutiny is bright; blessing the good is like an echo.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's scrutiny is bright; blessing good echoes.

sentences.zh: 乾封之禮，文德皇后配皇地祇，天后為亞獻，越國太妃為終獻。

translations.literal: Qianfeng rites: Empress Wende matched Imperial Earth Sovereign; the Heavenly Empress was secondary offerer; Yue great consort final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: Qianfeng: Wende matched Earth; Heavenly Empress secondary; Yue consort final.

sentences.zh: 宮闈接神，有乖舊典。

translations.literal: Inner palace contacting spirits violated old canon.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace contacting spirits violated canon.

sentences.zh: 上玄不祐，遂有天授易姓之事，宗社中圮，公族誅滅，皆由此也。

translations.literal: High Heaven did not aid; then came Tian-shou change of surname, state and clan mid-collapse, imperial kin extinguished—all from this.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven did not aid; Tian-shou surname change, state collapsed, kin extinguished—all from this.

sentences.zh: 景龍之季，有事圓丘，韋氏為亞獻，皆以婦人升壇執籩豆，渫黷穹蒼，享祀不潔。

translations.literal: In the Jinglong years, when there were affairs at the round mound, the Wei clan was secondary offerer—all had women ascend the altar holding baskets and vessels, defiling the azure vault; offering was not pure.
translations.idiomatic: Jinglong round-mound affairs: Wei clan secondary offerer—women on altar with baskets, defiling heaven; offering impure.

sentences.zh: 未及逾年，國有內難，終獻皆受其咎，掌座齋郎及女人執祭者，多亦夭卒。

translations.literal: Before a year passed there was internal calamity; final offerers all suffered blame; seat managers, abstention officers, and women holding sacrifice mostly also died young.
translations.idiomatic: Within a year internal calamity; final offerers blamed; seat managers and women mostly died young.

sentences.zh: 今主上尊天敬神，事資革正。

translations.literal: Now the sovereign honors Heaven and reveres spirits; the affair relies on reform.
translations.idiomatic: Now the sovereign honors Heaven; the affair relies on reform.

sentences.zh: 斯禮以睿宗大聖貞皇帝配皇地祇，侑神作主。」

translations.literal: This rite matches Emperor Ruizong the Great Sagely Pure Emperor to Imperial Earth Sovereign, assisting spirits as chief offering."
translations.idiomatic: This rite matches Ruizong Great Sagely Pure Emperor to Earth Sovereign as assisting chief.'"

sentences.zh: 乃定議奏聞。

translations.literal: They fixed the proposal and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: They fixed the proposal and submitted.

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed.

sentences.zh: 舊禮：郊祀既畢，收取玉帛牲體，置於柴上，然後燔於燎壇之上，其壇於神壇之左。

translations.literal: Old rites: when suburban sacrifice ended, jade, silk, and victim bodies were gathered, placed on firewood, then burned on the firewood altar; the altar was to the left of the spirit altar.
translations.idiomatic: Old rites: after suburban sacrifice, jade, silk, and victims were gathered on firewood and burned on the firewood altar left of the spirit altar.

sentences.zh: 顯慶中，禮部尚書許敬宗等因修改舊禮，乃奏曰：

translations.literal: In the Xianqing era, Minister of Rites Xu Jingzong and others, revising old rites, memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: Xianqing: Rites Minister Xu Jingzong and others, revising old rites, memorialized:

sentences.zh: 謹按祭祀之禮，周人尚臭，祭天則燔柴，祭地則瘞血，宗廟則焫蕭灌鬯，皆貴氣臭，同以降神。

translations.literal: We respectfully examine sacrifice rites: Zhou people valued aroma; sacrificing Heaven burns firewood, sacrificing Earth buries blood, ancestral temple burns wormwood and pours libation—all value qi aroma, alike to bring down spirits.
translations.idiomatic: We examine sacrifice: Zhou valued aroma—Heaven burns firewood, Earth buries blood, temple burns wormwood—all value aroma to bring spirits down.

sentences.zh: 禮經明白，義釋甚詳。

translations.literal: The ritual classics are clear; exegesis very detailed.
translations.idiomatic: Classics clear; exegesis detailed.

sentences.zh: 委柴在祭神之初，理無所惑。

translations.literal: Placing firewood at sacrifice's beginning—logically no confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Firewood at sacrifice's beginning—logically clear.

sentences.zh: 是以《三禮義宗》等並云：「祭天以燔柴為始，然後行正祭。

translations.literal: Therefore the Three Rites Meaning Summaries and others all say: "Sacrificing Heaven takes burning firewood as beginning, then performs the main sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Three Rites Meaning Summaries: "Heaven sacrifice begins burning firewood, then main sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 祭地以瘞血為先，然後行正祭。」

translations.literal: Sacrificing Earth takes burying blood as first, then performs the main sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: Earth sacrifice buries blood first, then main sacrifice.'"

sentences.zh: 又《禮論》說太常賀循上言：「積柴舊在壇南，燎祭天之牲，用犢左胖，漢儀用頭，今郊用脅之九個。

translations.literal: Also the Ritual Discussions state Grand Master of Sacrifices He Xun's memorial: "The firewood pile was formerly south of the altar; the victim for burning to Heaven used the left haunch; Han ceremonies used the head; present suburb uses nine rib pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual Discussions, He Xun: "Firewood formerly south of altar; Heaven victim left haunch; Han used head; present suburb nine ribs.

sentences.zh: 太宰令奉牲脅，太祝令奉圭璧，俱奠燎薪之上。」

translations.literal: The Grand Steward orders offering the rib haunch; the Grand Invoker orders offering gui and bi—both set on firewood above."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Steward offers rib; Grand Invoker offers gui-bi—both on firewood.'"

sentences.zh: 此即晉氏故事，亦無祭末之文。

translations.literal: This is Jin precedent; there is also no text on after sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Jin precedent; no after-sacrifice text.

sentences.zh: 既雲漢儀用牲頭，頭非神俎之物，且祭末俎皆升右胖之脅。

translations.literal: Since it says Han ceremonies used victim head, the head is not spirit-table food; moreover after-sacrifice table all raises right haunch ribs.
translations.idiomatic: Han used head—head is not spirit food; after-sacrifice table raises right ribs.

sentences.zh: 唯有《三禮》、賀循既雲用祭天之牲左胖，復雲今儀用脅九個，足明燔柴所用，與升俎不同。

translations.literal: Only the Three Rites and He Xun say left haunch for Heaven victim yet also say present ceremony uses nine ribs—clearly firewood burning uses different parts from ascending table.
translations.idiomatic: Three Rites and He Xun: left haunch yet nine ribs—firewood differs from table.

sentences.zh: 是知自在祭初，別燔牲體，非於祭末，燒神餘饌。

translations.literal: Thus one knows it is separately burning victim parts at sacrifice's beginning, not burning spirit leftovers after sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Thus separate burning at beginning, not leftovers after.

sentences.zh: 此則晉氏以前，仍遵古禮。

translations.literal: This means before Jin still followed ancient rites.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jin followed ancient rites.

sentences.zh: 唯周、魏以降，妄為損益。

translations.literal: Only from Zhou and Wei onward were reckless additions and subtractions made.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhou and Wei, reckless changes.

sentences.zh: 緣告廟之幣，事畢瘞埋，因改燔柴，將為祭末。

translations.literal: Because temple-announcement silks after the affair were buried, they changed firewood burning to after sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Temple silks buried after affair—they changed burning to after sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 事無典實，禮闕降神。

translations.literal: The affair has no canonical fact; rites lack bringing spirits down.
translations.idiomatic: No canonical fact; rites lack bringing spirits down.

sentences.zh: 又燔柴、正祭，牲、玉皆別。

translations.literal: Moreover firewood burning and main sacrifice—victims and jade are separate.
translations.idiomatic: Firewood and main sacrifice—victims and jade separate.

sentences.zh: 蒼璧蒼犢之流，柴之所用；

translations.literal: Dark blue bi and dark blue calf and the like are for firewood;

translations.idiomatic: Han Official Ceremonies: "Usher Vice Director, rank 600 shi, bronze seal blue cord;

sentences.zh: 謁者三十五人，以郎中歲稱給事，未滿歲稱灌謁者。

translations.literal: ushers thirty-five persons, drawn from directors annually as attendants; before full year called pouring ushers.
translations.idiomatic: ushers thirty-five, directors annually as attendants; before full year pouring ushers.

sentences.zh: 又按《漢書百官公卿表》：光祿勳官屬有郎中、員外，秩比二千石；

translations.literal: Also examining Han Book Officials and Salaries Table: Director of Luminous Fortune subordinates include directors and assistants, rank comparable 2000 shi;
translations.idiomatic: Han Officials Table: Luminous Fortune directors comparable 2000 shi;

sentences.zh: 有謁者，掌賓贊受事，員七十人，秩比六百石。

translations.literal: ushers manage guest praise and receiving affairs, seventy persons, rank comparable 600 shi.
translations.idiomatic: ushers manage guest praise, seventy, comparable 600 shi.

sentences.zh: 古之謁者，秩異等，今謁者班微，以之從事，可謂疏矣。

translations.literal: Ancient ushers' ranks differed in grade; today's ushers' class is slight—using them in the affair may be called careless.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient ushers differed in rank; today's slight—careless.

sentences.zh: 又曰：

translations.literal: Also it states:
translations.idiomatic: Also:

sentences.zh: 舊禮，尚書令奉玉牒，今無其官，請以中書令從事。

translations.literal: Old rites: Secretariat Director carries jade tablet; now no such office—request Central Secretariat Director serve.
translations.idiomatic: Old rites: Secretariat Director carries jade tablet; no such office—request Central Secretariat Director.

sentences.zh: 按漢武帝時，張安世為尚書令，游宴後宮，以宦者一人出入帝命，改為中書謁者令。

translations.literal: Examining Han Wudi's time, Zhang Anshi as Secretariat Director at banquets in rear palace—a eunuch one person conveyed imperial orders, changed to Central Secretariat Usher Director.
translations.idiomatic: Wudi: Zhang Anshi Secretariat Director; eunuch conveyed orders—changed to Central Secretariat Usher Director.

sentences.zh: 至成帝，罷宦者，用士人。

translations.literal: By Chengdi, eunuchs abolished, scholars used.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdi: eunuchs abolished, scholars used.

sentences.zh: 魏黃初改秘書，置中書監令。

translations.literal: Wei Huangchu changed Secretariat, established Central Secretariat Director and Supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Huangchu: established Central Secretariat Director and Supervisor.

sentences.zh: 舊尚書並掌制誥，既置中書官，而制誥樞密皆掌焉。

translations.literal: Former Secretariat all managed edicts; once Central Secretariat offices established, edicts and secret pivot all managed.
translations.idiomatic: Former Secretariat managed edicts; Central Secretariat took edicts and secrets.

sentences.zh: 則自魏以來，中書是漢朝尚書之職。

translations.literal: Thus from Wei onward Central Secretariat is Han Secretariat's duty.
translations.idiomatic: From Wei, Central Secretariat is Han Secretariat's duty.

sentences.zh: 今尚書令奉玉牒，是用漢禮，其官既闕，故可以中書令主之。」

translations.literal: Now Secretariat Director carrying jade tablet uses Han rites; the office lacking, therefore Central Secretariat Director may preside."
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Director carrying tablet is Han rite; office lacking—Central Secretariat Director presides."

sentences.zh: 議奏，玄宗令張說、徐堅召敬本與之對議詳定，說等奏曰：「敬本所議，其中四條，先已改定。

translations.literal: Proposal submitted; Xuanzong ordered Zhang Yue and Xu Jian to summon Jingben for detailed debate; Yue and others submitted: "Of Jingben's proposals, four articles were already revised.
translations.idiomatic: Submitted; Xuanzong ordered Zhang Yue and Xu Jian to summon Jingben; Yue submitted: "Four of Jingben's articles already revised.

sentences.zh: 有不同者，望臨時量事改攝。」

translations.literal: Where different, hope at the time to measure affairs and change provisionally."
translations.idiomatic: Where different, hope to measure affairs provisionally.'"

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: Edict followed.
translations.idiomatic: Edict followed.

sentences.zh: 十三年十一月丙戌，至泰山，去山趾五里，西去社首山三里。

translations.literal: On bingxu of the eleventh month of the thirteenth year they reached Mount Tai, five li from the mountain foot, three li west of Sheshou Hill.
translations.idiomatic: Month 11 bingxu: reached Tai, five li from foot, three li west of Sheshou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，玄宗服袞冕於行宮，致齋於供帳前殿。

translations.literal: On dinghai Xuanzong wore dragon robe at the traveling palace, abstained before the supply pavilion front hall.
translations.idiomatic: dinghai: Xuanzong dragon robe at palace, abstained before supply hall.

sentences.zh: 己丑，日南至，大備法駕，至山下。

translations.literal: On jichou, winter solstice, full imperial guard reached below the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: jichou solstice: full guard below mountain.

sentences.zh: 玄宗禦馬而登，侍臣從。

translations.literal: Xuanzong rode horse up; attendants followed.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong rode up; attendants followed.

sentences.zh: 先是玄宗以靈山清潔，不欲多人上，欲初獻於山上壇行事，亞獻、終獻於山下壇行事。

translations.literal: Earlier Xuanzong, because the spirit mountain was pure and clean and he did not wish many up, wished initial offering on the mountain altar, secondary and final on the altar below.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, mountain pure, few up—initial on mountain, secondary and final below.

sentences.zh: 因召禮官學士賀知章等入講儀注，因問之，知章等奏曰：「昊天上帝，君位；

translations.literal: He summoned ritual officials and scholars He Zhizhang and others to discuss regulations and asked; Zhizhang and others submitted: "August Heaven is sovereign position;
translations.idiomatic: He summoned He Zhizhang and others; they submitted: "August Heaven is sovereign position;

sentences.zh: 五方時帝，臣位；

translations.literal: Five Directional Seasonal Lords are minister position;
translations.idiomatic: Five Directional Seasonal Lords minister position;

sentences.zh: 帝號雖同，而君臣異位。

translations.literal: titles same but sovereign and minister positions differ.
translations.idiomatic: titles same but positions differ.

sentences.zh: 陛下享君位於山上，群臣祀臣位於山下，誠足以垂范來葉，為變禮之大者也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty enjoys sovereign position on the mountain; ministers sacrifice minister position below—truly enough to set example for coming generations, a great change in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Sovereign on mountain, ministers below—example for generations, great ritual change.

sentences.zh: 禮成于三，初獻、亞、終，合於一處。」

translations.literal: Rite completes in three—initial, secondary, final—united in one place."
translations.idiomatic: Rite completes in three—initial, secondary, final united.'"

sentences.zh: 玄宗曰：「朕正欲如是，故問卿耳。」

translations.literal: Xuanzong said: "I just want exactly this, therefore I asked you."
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong said, "I just want exactly this—that is why I asked.'"

sentences.zh: 於是敕三獻於山上行事，其五方帝及諸神座於山下壇行事。

translations.literal: Thereupon edict: three offerings on the mountain; Five Directional Lords and spirit seats on the altar below.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: three offerings on mountain; Five Lords and spirits below.

sentences.zh: 玄宗因問：「玉牒之文，前代帝王，何故秘之？」

translations.literal: Xuanzong therefore asked: "Jade tablet text—why did former dynasties' emperors keep it secret?"
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong asked, "Why did former emperors keep jade tablet text secret?'"

sentences.zh: 知章對曰：「玉牒本是通於神明之意。

translations.literal: Zhizhang replied: "Jade tablet originally communicates with spirits' intent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhizhang replied, "Jade tablet communicates with spirits.

sentences.zh: 前代帝王，所求各異，或禱年算，或思神仙，其事微密，是故莫知之。」

translations.literal: Former emperors' requests each differed—some prayed for years, some sought immortals; the affair was minute and secret, therefore none knew."
translations.idiomatic: Former requests differed—years, immortals; minute and secret—none knew.'"

sentences.zh: 玄宗曰：「朕今此行，皆為蒼生祈福，更無秘請。

translations.literal: Xuanzong said: "My journey now is all to bless the people—no secret prayer.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong said, "My journey blesses the people—no secret prayer.

sentences.zh: 宜將玉牒出示百僚；

translations.literal: The jade tablet should be shown to officials;
translations.idiomatic: Show jade tablet to officials;

sentences.zh: 使知朕意。」

translations.literal: let them know my intent."
translations.idiomatic: let them know my intent.'"

sentences.zh: 其辭曰：「有唐嗣天子臣某，敢昭告於昊天上帝。

translations.literal: Its text: "Tang heir Son of Heaven, your servant so-and-so, ventures to announce to August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Text: "Tang heir Son of Heaven, your servant so-and-so, ventures to announce to August Heaven.

sentences.zh: 天啟李氏，運興土德。

translations.literal: Heaven opened the Li clan; fortune rose in earth virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven opened Li; fortune rose in earth virtue.

sentences.zh: 高祖、太宗，受命立極。

translations.literal: Gaozu and Taizong received the Mandate and established the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu and Taizong received Mandate, established pole.

sentences.zh: 高宗升中，六合殷盛。

translations.literal: Gaozong ascended center; six quarters abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong ascended center; six quarters abundant.

sentences.zh: 中宗紹復，繼體不足。

translations.literal: Zhongzong restored succession; continuing the body insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong restored succession; continuing insufficient.

sentences.zh: 上帝眷祐，錫臣忠武。

translations.literal: August Heaven favored and aided, bestowed loyal martial on your servant.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven favored, bestowed loyal martial.

sentences.zh: 底綏內難，推戴聖父。

translations.literal: Settled internal hardship, elevated sagely father.
translations.idiomatic: Settled internal hardship, elevated sagely father.

sentences.zh: 恭承大寶，十有三年。

translations.literal: Respectfully received great treasure—thirteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Received great treasure—thirteen years.

sentences.zh: 敬若天意，四海晏然。

translations.literal: Reverent as Heaven's intent; four quarters tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent as Heaven's intent; four quarters tranquil.

sentences.zh: 封祀岱岳，謝成於天。

translations.literal: Feng and sacrifice at Dai, thanks completed to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and sacrifice at Dai, thanks to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 子孫百祿，蒼生受福。」

translations.literal: Descendants' hundred blessings; the people receive fortune."
translations.idiomatic: Descendants' blessings; people receive fortune.'"

sentences.zh: 庚寅，祀昊天上帝于山上封台之前壇，高祖神堯皇帝配享焉。

translations.literal: On gengyin he sacrificed to August Heaven before the feng altar atop the mountain, with High Ancestor Shenyao Emperor as associate.
translations.idiomatic: gengyin: sacrificed to August Heaven at mountain feng altar, Shenyao as associate.

sentences.zh: 邠王守禮亞獻，甯王憲終獻。

translations.literal: Prince of Bin Shouli secondary offerer; Prince of Ning Xian final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Bin Shouli secondary; Prince of Ning Xian final.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲福酒。

translations.literal: The emperor drank blessing wine.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor drank blessing wine.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，中書令張說進稱：「天賜皇帝太一神策，周而復始，永綏兆人。」

translations.literal: On guisi Central Secretariat Director Zhang Yue advanced stating: "Heaven bestowed the emperor the Grand Unity divine tally; cycle complete, forever securing the myriad people."
translations.idiomatic: guisi Zhang Yue: "Heaven bestowed Grand Unity divine tally; cycle complete, securing myriad people.'"

sentences.zh: 帝拜稽首。

translations.literal: The emperor bowed forehead to ground.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor bowed forehead to ground.

sentences.zh: 山上作圓臺四階，謂之封壇。

translations.literal: Atop the mountain a round terrace with four flights was made, called the feng altar.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain round terrace four flights—feng altar.

sentences.zh: 臺上有方石再累，謂之石感玉牒、玉策，刻玉填金為字，各盛以玉匱，束以金繩，封以金泥，皇帝以受命寶印之。

translations.literal: Atop the terrace layered square stones, called stone receptacle; jade tablet and jade slips, characters carved in jade and gold-filled, each stored in jade casket, bound with gold cord, sealed with gold mud; emperor impressed with Seal of Receiving the Mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Layered square stones—stone receptacle; jade tablet and slips gold-filled, jade caskets, gold cord, gold mud, Mandate seal.

sentences.zh: 納二玉匱於感中，金泥堿際，以「天下同文」之印封之。

translations.literal: Two jade caskets placed in receptacle; gold mud at seams, sealed with 'All Under Heaven One Script' seal.
translations.idiomatic: Two jade caskets in receptacle; gold mud; 'All Under Heaven One Script' seal.

sentences.zh: 壇東南為燎壇，積柴其上。

translations.literal: Southeast of altar a firewood altar, firewood piled atop.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast firewood altar, firewood piled.

sentences.zh: 皇帝就望燎位，火發，群臣稱萬歲，傳呼下山下，聲動天地。

translations.literal: Emperor took observation-burning position; fire rose; ministers called ten thousand years; calls passed down the mountain—sound shook heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor at burning position; fire rose; ten thousand years; sound shook heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 山下壇祀，群臣行事已畢，皇帝未離位，命中書門下曰：「朕以薄德，恭膺大寶。

translations.literal: Below altar sacrifice: when ministers' rites finished, emperor had not left position; ordered Secretariat Gate-Down: "I with meager virtue respectfully received great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Below sacrifice finished; emperor ordered Secretariat: "Meager virtue, great treasure.

sentences.zh: 今封祀初建，雲物休祐，皆是卿等輔弼之力。

translations.literal: Now feng and sacrifice newly established, cloud objects auspicious—all your assisting power.
translations.idiomatic: Feng newly established, auspicious—all your power.

sentences.zh: 君臣相保，勉副天心，長如今日，不敢矜怠。」

translations.literal: Sovereign and ministers preserve one another, striving to match Heaven's heart, long as today, not daring pride and slackness."
translations.idiomatic: Preserve one another, match Heaven, long as today, not slack.'"

sentences.zh: 中書令張說跪言：「聖心誠懇，宿齋山上。

translations.literal: Central Secretariat Director Zhang Yue knelt: "Sagely heart sincere, abstained atop mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue knelt: "Sagely heart sincere, abstained atop mountain.

sentences.zh: 昨夜則息風收雨，今朝則天清日暖，復有祥風助樂，卿雲引燎，靈跡盛事，千古未聞。

translations.literal: Last night winds ceased and rain gathered; this morning sky clear and sun warm; again auspicious wind aided music, auspicious clouds drew burning—spirit traces and grand affair, unheard in a thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: Last night wind ceased; today clear and warm; auspicious wind and clouds—unheard in ages.

sentences.zh: 陛下又思慎終如初。

translations.literal: Your Majesty also thinks careful end as beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty careful end as beginning.

sentences.zh: 長福萬姓，天下幸甚。」

translations.literal: Long fortune for myriad people—world greatly fortunate."
translations.idiomatic: Long fortune for myriad people—world fortunate.'"

sentences.zh: 先是車駕至岳西來蘇頓，有大風從東北來，自午至夕，裂幕折柱，眾恐。

translations.literal: Earlier when the carriage reached Laisu post west of the peak, a great wind came from northeast from noon to evening, tearing curtains and breaking pillars—crowd feared.
translations.idiomatic: At Laisu post great northeast wind noon to evening—curtains torn, pillars broken—fear.

sentences.zh: 張說倡言曰：「此必是海神來迎也。」

translations.literal: Zhang Yue proclaimed: "This must be the sea spirit coming to welcome."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue proclaimed, "Sea spirit coming to welcome.'"

sentences.zh: 及至嶽下，天地清晏。

translations.literal: When they reached below the peak, heaven and earth clear and tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Below peak: clear and tranquil.

sentences.zh: 玄宗登山，日氣和煦。

translations.literal: Xuanzong ascended; sun's warmth genial.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong ascended; sun genial.

sentences.zh: 至齋次日入後，勁風偃人，寒氣切骨。

translations.literal: Next abstention day after entering, strong wind bowed people, cold qi cut bone.
translations.idiomatic: Next abstention day: strong wind, cold cut bone.

sentences.zh: 玄宗因不食，次前露立，至夜半，仰天稱：「某身有過，請即降罰。

translations.literal: Xuanzong therefore did not eat; stood in open before dawn to midnight, lifted face to heaven: "My person has fault—please immediately send punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Did not eat; stood open to midnight: "My fault—send punishment.

sentences.zh: 若萬人無福，亦請某為當罪。

translations.literal: If myriad people without fortune, also request I bear guilt.
translations.idiomatic: If people without fortune, I bear guilt.

sentences.zh: 兵馬辛苦，乞停風寒。」

translations.literal: Soldiers and horses laboring—beg stop wind and cold."
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers laboring—stop wind and cold.'"

sentences.zh: 應時風止，山氣溫暖。

translations.literal: Wind immediately ceased; mountain air warm.
translations.idiomatic: Wind ceased; mountain air warm.

sentences.zh: 時從山上布兵至於山壇，傳呼辰刻及詔命來往，斯須而達。

translations.literal: At the time from mountain troops to altar, calls of time and edicts passed—instant arrival.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain troops to altar—time calls and edicts instant.

sentences.zh: 夜中燃火相屬，山下望之，有如連星自地屬天。

translations.literal: Midnight fires continuous; below looking up like linked stars from earth to heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Midnight fires continuous—like linked stars earth to heaven.

sentences.zh: 其日平明，山上清迥，下望山下，休氣四塞，登歌奏樂，有祥風自南而至，絲竹之聲，飄若天外。

translations.literal: That day at dawn, mountain clear; below looking down, auspicious qi filled four quarters; ascending song and music—auspicious wind from south, silk-bamboo sound floating beyond heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn: mountain clear; auspicious qi; music—wind from south, sound beyond heaven.

sentences.zh: 及行事，日揚火光，慶雲紛郁，遍滿天際。

translations.literal: At the rite, sun raised fire-light; celebratory clouds dense, filling the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Rite: sun fire-light; celebratory clouds filling sky.

sentences.zh: 群臣並集於社首山帷宮之次，以候鑾駕，遙望紫煙憧憧上達，內外歡噪。

translations.literal: Ministers all gathered at Sheshou Hill curtain palace to await the carriage; gazing afar purple smoke thick ascending—inside and outside rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers at Sheshou curtain palace—purple smoke ascending—rejoicing.

sentences.zh: 玄宗自山上便赴社首齋次，辰巳間至，日色明朗，慶雲不散。

translations.literal: Xuanzong from mountain directly to Sheshou abstention; between chen and si arrived—sun bright, celebratory clouds unbroken.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong to Sheshou abstention; chen-si arrived—sun bright, clouds unbroken.

sentences.zh: 百辟及蕃夷爭前迎賀。

translations.literal: Hundred ministers and foreigners competed forward to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and foreigners competed to congratulate.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，享地祇於社首之泰折壇，睿宗大聖貞皇帝配祀。

translations.literal: On xinmao offered to Earth Sovereign at Sheshou's Taizhe altar, with Ruizong Great Sagely Pure Emperor as matched sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: xinmao: Earth Sovereign at Taizhe, Ruizong matched.

sentences.zh: 五色雲見，日重輪。

translations.literal: Five-colored clouds appeared; sun double halo.
translations.idiomatic: Five-colored clouds; sun double halo.

sentences.zh: 藏玉策于石感，如封壇之儀。

translations.literal: Stored jade slips in stone receptacle as at feng altar.
translations.idiomatic: Stored jade slips in stone receptacle as feng altar.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，玄宗禦朝覲之帳殿，大備陳布。

translations.literal: On renchen Xuanzong attended the Grand Audience tent hall, fully arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: renchen: Grand Audience tent, fully arrayed.

sentences.zh: 文武百僚，二王后，孔子後，諸方朝集使，岳牧舉賢良及儒生、文士上賦頌者，戎狄夷蠻羌胡朝獻之國，突厥頡利發，契丹、奚等王，大食、謝褷、五天十姓，昆侖、日本、新羅、靺鞨之侍子及使，內臣之番，高麗朝鮮王，百濟帶方王，十姓摩阿史那興昔可汗，三十姓左右賢王，日南、西竺、鑿齒、雕題、牂柯、烏滸之酋長，咸在位。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials, two Zhou kings' descendants, Confucius' descendants, assembly envoys from all quarters, prefects recommending worthies and Confucians and literary men presenting fu and eulogies, foreign tributary states, Tujue Irbis Qaghan, Khitan and Xi kings, Dashi and Shache, Five Tian ten surnames, Kunlun, Japan, Silla, Mohe hostages and envoys, inner eunuchs' rotations, Goguryeo Korean king, Baekje Daifang king, ten-surname Mohe Ashina Xingxi Qaghan, thirty-surname left and right wise kings, chiefs of Rinan, Xizhu, Zaoshi, Diaoti, Zangke, Wupu—all in position.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, Zhou and Confucius descendants, envoys, tributaries, Tujue, Khitan, Xi, Dashi, Kunlun, Japan, Silla, Mohe, eunuchs, Goguryeo, Baekje, Ashina, chiefs—all in position.

sentences.zh: 制曰：

translations.literal: Edict:
translations.idiomatic: Edict:

sentences.zh: 朕聞天監唯後，後克奉天，既合德以受命，亦推功而復始。

translations.literal: I have heard Heaven's scrutiny only aids the successor; the successor can serve Heaven—having united virtue to receive the Mandate, also extending merit and returning to beginning.
translations.idiomatic: I hear Heaven aids successor who serves Heaven—virtue receives Mandate, merit returns to beginning.

sentences.zh: 厥初作者七十二君，道洽跡著，時至符出，皆用事於介丘，升中於上帝。

translations.literal: The first makers were seventy-two lords; the Way pervaded and traces showed; when the time came talismans emerged—all used affairs at Jie Hill, ascending center to August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: First makers seventy-two lords; Way pervaded; talismans emerged—affairs at Jie Hill, center to August Heaven.

sentences.zh: 人神之望，蓋有以塞之，皇王之序，可得而言。

translations.literal: Human and spirit expectation—surely something to fill it; royal king's order—may be spoken.
translations.idiomatic: Human and spirit expectation filled; royal order spoken.

sentences.zh: 朕接統千歲，承光五葉，惟祖宗之德在人，惟天地之靈作主。

translations.literal: I have received succession for a thousand years, inherited glory five generations—only ancestors' virtue in people, only Heaven and Earth's spirits as chief.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-year succession, five generations' glory—ancestors' virtue, Heaven and Earth as chief.

sentences.zh: 往者內難，幽贊而集大勳；

translations.literal: Formerly internal hardship—dark aid gathered great merit;
translations.idiomatic: Former internal hardship—dark aid gathered merit;

sentences.zh: 間無外虞，守成而纘舊服。

translations.literal: interval without external worry—guarded accomplishment and continued old service.
translations.idiomatic: interval without external worry—guarded accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 未嘗不乾乾終日，思與公卿大夫上下協心，聿求至理，以弘我烈聖，其庶乎馨香。

translations.literal: Never not diligent all day, thinking with dukes, ministers, and grandees above and below united in heart, seeking ultimate principle, to expand my fierce sages—perhaps fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent all day, united with ministers seeking principle—to expand fierce sages.

sentences.zh: 今九有大寧，群氓樂業，時必敬授而不奪，物亦順成而無夭。

translations.literal: Now nine regions greatly tranquil, masses joyful in occupation; seasons respectfully granted without seizure; things also follow completion without early death.
translations.idiomatic: Nine regions tranquil; masses joyful; seasons granted; things complete.

sentences.zh: 懋建皇極，幸致太和。

translations.literal: Diligently establishing imperial pole, fortunately reaching great harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing imperial pole, reaching harmony.

sentences.zh: 洎乃幽遐，率由感被。

translations.literal: Even remote regions—all by feeling covered.
translations.idiomatic: Remote regions by feeling covered.

sentences.zh: 戎狄不至，唯文告而來庭；

translations.literal: Barbarians not arriving—only by civil edict coming to court;
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians by civil edict to court;

sentences.zh: 麟鳳已臻，將覺情而在藪。

translations.literal: unicorn and phoenix already arrived—about to awaken feeling in the thicket.
translations.idiomatic: unicorn and phoenix arrived—awakening in thicket.

sentences.zh: 以故凡百執事，亟言大封。

translations.literal: Therefore all hundred officiants urgently spoke great feng.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred officiants urgently spoke great feng.

sentences.zh: 顧惟不德，切欲勿議。

translations.literal: Considering my lack of virtue—I deeply wished not to debate.
translations.idiomatic: Lacking virtue—I wished not to debate.

sentences.zh: 伏以先聖儲祉，與天同功，荷傳符以在今，敢侑神而無報。

translations.literal: Humbly—former sages stored blessing, same merit as Heaven; bearing transmitted tally today—I dare assist spirits without repayment.
translations.idiomatic: Former sages stored blessing; bearing tally today—dare assist spirits without repayment.

sentences.zh: 大篇斯在，朕何讓焉。

translations.literal: The great document is here—what would I yield?
translations.idiomatic: Great document here—what yield?

sentences.zh: 遂奉遵高宗之舊章，憲乾封之令典，時邁東土，柴告岱嶽，百神群望，莫不懷柔，四方諸侯，莫不來慶，斯是天下之介福，邦家之耿光也。

translations.literal: Therefore I respectfully followed Gaozong's old regulations, honored Qianfeng's fine canon, advanced in season to eastern lands, offered firewood and announced at Dai Peak—hundred spirits and all outlooks none not gentle; four quarters' lords none not celebrating—this is the realm's mediating fortune, the state's brilliant glory.
translations.idiomatic: Followed Gaozong's regulations, Qianfeng's canon, eastern lands, Dai Peak—spirits gentle, lords celebrating—realm's fortune, state's glory.

sentences.zh: 無窮之休祉，豈獨在予；

translations.literal: Endless blessing—how could it be only in me;
translations.idiomatic: Endless blessing—not only in me;

sentences.zh: 非常之惠澤，亦宜逮下。

translations.literal: extraordinary grace—also should reach below.
translations.idiomatic: extraordinary grace should reach below.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下。

translations.literal: Great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Great amnesty for all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 封泰山神為天齊王，禮秩加三公一等，仍令所管崇飾祠廟，環山十里，禁其樵采。

translations.literal: Feng Mount Tai spirit as King Equalizing Heaven; ritual rank one grade above three dukes; still order managed splendid shrine, encircling mountain ten li, forbidding fuel gathering.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Tai spirit as King Equalizing Heaven; rank above three dukes; splendid shrine, ten li forbidden gathering.

sentences.zh: 給近山二十戶復，以奉祠神。

translations.literal: Grant twenty households near mountain exemption to serve shrine spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty households near mountain exempt to serve shrine.

sentences.zh: 玄宗制《紀太山銘》，御書勒於山頂石壁之上。

translations.literal: Xuanzong composed Inscription Commemorating Mount Tai, imperial brush carved on mountain peak stone wall.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong composed Inscription Commemorating Mount Tai, carved on peak.

sentences.zh: 其辭曰：

translations.literal: Its text:
translations.idiomatic: Text:

sentences.zh: 朕宅帝位，十有四載，顧惟不德，懵於至道，任夫難任，安夫難安，茲朕未知獲戾於上下，心之浩蕩，若涉大川。

translations.literal: I occupy imperial position fourteen years; considering my lack of virtue, ignorant of ultimate Way, undertaking hard undertakings, securing hard security—if I do not know offense before above and below, heart vast and unsettled as crossing great river.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen years imperial position; lacking virtue, ignorant; heart unsettled as crossing river.

sentences.zh: 賴上帝垂休，先後儲慶，宰相庶尹，交修皇極，四海會同，五典敷暢，歲雲嘉熟，人用大和。

translations.literal: Relying on August Heaven's favor, former and later stored celebration, chancellors and officials jointly cultivating imperial pole—four quarters united, five canons spread, years called abundant harvest, people use great harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's favor, celebration stored, officials cultivating pole—four quarters united, harvest abundant, great harmony.

sentences.zh: 百辟僉謀，唱余封禪，謂孝莫大于嚴父，禮莫盛於告天，天符既至，人望既積，固請不已，固辭不獲。

translations.literal: Hundred ministers all proposed, urging my feng-shan—saying filial none greater than honoring father, ritual none greater than announcing Heaven; Heaven's tally arrived, people's expectation accumulated—firmly requesting without cease, firmly declining without obtaining.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred ministers urged feng-shan—filial honors father, ritual announces Heaven; tally arrived—requesting without cease, declining without obtaining.

sentences.zh: 肆餘與夫二三臣，稽虞《典》，繹漢制，張惶六師，震讋九宇。

translations.literal: Therefore I with two or three ministers examined Yu Canon, traced Han institutions, displayed six armies, shaking nine realms.
translations.idiomatic: With ministers examined Yu Canon, traced Han institutions, six armies shaking nine realms.

sentences.zh: 旌旗有列，士馬無嘩，肅肅邕邕，翼翼溶溶，以至岱宗，順也。

translations.literal: Banners arrayed, soldiers and horses without clamor—solemn and harmonious, orderly and flowing—to reaching Dai Peak: fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Banners arrayed, without clamor—solemn—to Dai Peak: fitting.

sentences.zh: 《爾雅》曰：「泰山為東嶽。」

translations.literal: Erya says: "Mount Tai is Eastern Peak."
translations.idiomatic: Erya: "Mount Tai is Eastern Peak.'"

sentences.zh: 《周官》曰：「兗州之鎮山。」

translations.literal: Zhou Offices says: "Yanzhou's guardian mountain."
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Offices: "Yanzhou's guardian mountain.'"

sentences.zh: 實萬物之始，故稱岱焉；

translations.literal: Truly all things' beginning—therefore called Dai;
translations.idiomatic: All things' beginning—called Dai;

sentences.zh: 其位居五嶽之伯，故稱宗焉。

translations.literal: its position chief of five peaks—therefore called zong.
translations.idiomatic: chief of five peaks—called zong.

sentences.zh: 自昔王者受命易姓，於是乎啟天地，薦成功，序圖錄，紀氏號。

translations.literal: From old when kings received Mandate and changed surname—thereupon opened Heaven and Earth, presented success, ordered charts and records, recorded clan titles.
translations.idiomatic: Kings received Mandate—opened Heaven and Earth, presented success, recorded clans.

sentences.zh: 朕統承先王，茲率厥典，實欲報玄天之眷命，為蒼生而祈福，豈敢高祝千古，自比九皇哉！

translations.literal: I inherit former kings, now lead these canons—truly wishing to repay dark Heaven's favoring Mandate, bless the people—how dare high prayer through ages, compare myself to nine emperors!
translations.idiomatic: Inherit former kings, lead canons—repay Heaven, bless people—how dare compare to nine emperors!

sentences.zh: 故設壇場於山下，受群方之助祭；

translations.literal: Therefore set altar field below mountain, receiving all quarters' assisting sacrifice;
translations.idiomatic: Set altar below, receiving assisting sacrifice;

sentences.zh: 躬封燎於山上，冀一獻之通神。

translations.literal: personally feng-burned atop mountain, hoping one offering communicates with spirits.
translations.idiomatic: personally burned atop, hoping one offering reaches spirits.

sentences.zh: 斯亦因高崇天，就廣增地之義也。

translations.literal: This also follows honoring height and revering Heaven, expanding breadth and augmenting earth's meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring height, revering Heaven; expanding breadth, augmenting earth.

sentences.zh: 乃仲冬庚寅，有事東嶽，類於上帝，配我高祖。

translations.literal: Then mid-winter gengyin, affairs at Eastern Peak, classified to August Heaven, matching my High Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Mid-winter gengyin, Eastern Peak, classified to August Heaven, matching High Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 在天之神，罔不畢降。

translations.literal: Spirits in Heaven—none not all descending.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits in Heaven—all descending.

sentences.zh: 粵翌日，禪於社首，佑我聖考，祀於皇祇。

translations.literal: Next day shaned at Sheshou, assisting my Sagely Father, sacrificed to Imperial Sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: Next day shaned at Sheshou, assisting Sagely Father, sacrificed to Imperial Sovereign.

sentences.zh: 在地之神，罔不鹹舉。

translations.literal: Spirits on Earth—none not all rising.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits on Earth—all rising.

sentences.zh: 暨壬辰，覲群後，上公進曰：「天子膺天符，納介福。

translations.literal: By renchen, viewing all lords, chief duke advanced: "Son of Heaven received Heaven's tally, received mediating fortune.
translations.idiomatic: renchen viewing lords, chief duke: "Son of Heaven received tally, mediating fortune.

sentences.zh: 群臣拜稽首，呼萬歲。

translations.literal: Ministers bowed forehead to ground, called ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers bowed, ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 慶合歡同，乃陳誡以德。

translations.literal: Celebration united joy same—then admonished with virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Celebration united—admonished with virtue.

sentences.zh: 大渾協度，彝倫攸敘，三事百揆，時乃之功。

translations.literal: Great harmony harmonized measures, constant relations ordered—three affairs hundred managers, timely their merit.
translations.idiomatic: Great harmony, relations ordered—managers' merit.

sentences.zh: 萬物由庚，兆人允植，列牧眾宰，時乃之功。

translations.literal: Myriad people by geng established, masses truly planted—prefects and hosts, timely their merit.
translations.idiomatic: Myriad people established, masses planted—prefects' merit.

sentences.zh: 一二兄弟，篤行孝友，錫類萬國，時唯休哉！

translations.literal: One-two brothers, sincere filial friendship, bestowing kindred myriad states—timely only excellent!
translations.idiomatic: Brothers filial, bestowing states—excellent!

sentences.zh: 我儒制禮，我史作樂，天地擾順，時唯休哉！

translations.literal: Our Confucians made ritual, our historians made music—Heaven and Earth docile, timely only excellent!
translations.idiomatic: Confucians ritual, historians music—Heaven and Earth docile—excellent!

sentences.zh: 蠻夷戎狄，重譯來貢，累聖之化，朕何慕焉。

translations.literal: Barbarians and foreigners, repeated translation presenting tribute—accumulated sages' transformation—what would I admire?
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians presenting tribute—sages' transformation—what admire?

sentences.zh: 五靈百寶，日來月集，會昌之運，朕何惑焉。

translations.literal: Five spirits hundred treasures, daily coming monthly gathering—confluence fortune's movement—what would I doubt?
translations.idiomatic: Five spirits hundred treasures gathering—confluence fortune—what doubt?

sentences.zh: 凡今而後，儆乃在位，一王度，齊象法，權舊章，補缺政，存易簡，去煩苛。

translations.literal: From now afterward, warn those in position—one king's measure, align elephant law, weigh old regulations, supplement lacking government, preserve easy simplicity, remove troublesome severity.
translations.idiomatic: Warn those in position—align law, supplement government, preserve simplicity.

sentences.zh: 思立人極，乃見天則。

translations.literal: Think establishing human pole—then see Heaven's rule.
translations.idiomatic: Establish human pole—see Heaven's rule.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 天生蒸人，惟後時乂，能以美利利天下，事天明矣。

translations.literal: Heaven born the masses—only the successor timely governs; able with beautiful benefit to benefit all under Heaven—affair Heaven bright.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven born masses—successor governs; beautiful benefit—all under Heaven bright.

sentences.zh: 地德載物，惟後時相，能以厚生生萬人，事地察矣。

translations.literal: Earth virtue carries things—only the successor timely assists; able with thick life to give life to myriad people—affair Earth examined.
translations.idiomatic: Earth carries things—successor assists; thick life—myriad people examined.

sentences.zh: 天地明察，鬼神著矣。

translations.literal: Heaven and Earth bright examined—spirits manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth examined—spirits manifest.

sentences.zh: 惟我藝祖文考，精爽在天，其曰「懿爾幼孫，克享上帝。

translations.literal: Only my Artistic Ancestor Civil Father, essence bright in Heaven, saying "Excellent you young grandson, able to enjoy August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Artistic Ancestor Civil Father in Heaven: "Excellent young grandson, enjoy August Heaven.

sentences.zh: 惟帝時若，馨香其下」，丕乃曰「有唐氏文武之曾孫隆基，誕錫新命，纘我舊業，永保天祿，子孫其承之」。

translations.literal: Only August Sovereign timely like, fragrance below"—greatly then saying "Tang clan civil-martial great-great-grandson Longji, bestowed new Mandate, continuing my old enterprise, forever preserving Heaven's emolument—descendants inherit it."
translations.idiomatic: August Sovereign like, fragrance below"—"Tang Longji, new Mandate, old enterprise, Heaven's emolument—descendants inherit.'"

sentences.zh: 餘小子敢對揚上帝之休命，則亦與百執事尚綏兆人，將多於前功，而毖彼後患。

translations.literal: I young person venture to respond and display August Heaven's fine Mandate—then also with hundred officiants still securing myriad people, will exceed former merit and caution that later trouble.
translations.idiomatic: I venture respond Heaven's Mandate—with hundred officiants securing people, exceed former merit, caution later trouble.

sentences.zh: 一夫不獲，萬方其罪予。

translations.literal: One man not obtained—myriad quarters their guilt on me.
translations.idiomatic: One man not obtained—myriad quarters' guilt on me.

sentences.zh: 一心有終，上天其知我。

translations.literal: One heart has end—above Heaven knows me.
translations.idiomatic: One heart has end—Heaven knows me.

sentences.zh: 朕惟寶行三德，曰慈、儉、謙。

translations.literal: I treasure practicing three virtues—called kindness, frugality, humility.
translations.idiomatic: I treasure three virtues—kindness, frugality, humility.

sentences.zh: 慈者，覆無疆之言；

translations.literal: Kindness—covering boundless words;
translations.idiomatic: Kindness—covering boundless words;

sentences.zh: 儉者，崇將來之訓；

translations.literal: frugality—honoring coming instruction;
translations.idiomatic: frugality—honoring coming instruction;

sentences.zh: 自滿者人損，自謙者天益。

translations.literal: self-full people's loss, self-humble Heaven's gain.
translations.idiomatic: self-full loss, self-humble Heaven's gain.

sentences.zh: 苟如是，則軌跡易循，基構易守。

translations.literal: If so—then tracks easy to follow, foundation easy to guard.
translations.idiomatic: So—tracks easy, foundation easy.

sentences.zh: 磨石璧，刻金石，冀後人之聽辭而見心，觀末而知本。」

translations.literal: Grinding stone bi, carving metal and stone—hoping later people hearing words see heart, viewing end know root."
translations.idiomatic: Grinding bi, carving stone—later people see heart, end know root."

sentences.zh: 銘曰：

translations.literal: Inscription says:
translations.idiomatic: Inscription:

sentences.zh: 維天生人，立君以理，維君受命，奉天為子。

translations.literal: Only Heaven born people, established ruler to govern; only ruler received Mandate, served Heaven as son.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven born people, ruler governs; ruler received Mandate, Heaven's son.

sentences.zh: 代去不留，人來無已，德涼者滅，道高斯起。

translations.literal: Age departs not staying, people come without end; virtue thin perishes, Way high then rises.
translations.idiomatic: Age departs, people come; thin virtue perishes, high Way rises.

sentences.zh: 赫赫高祖，明明太宗，爰革隋政，奄有萬邦。

translations.literal: Illustrious High Ancestor, bright Taizong—reformed Sui government, suddenly possessed myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: Illustrious Gaozu, bright Taizong—reformed Sui, possessed states.

sentences.zh: 罄天張宇，盡地開封，武稱有截，文表時邕。

translations.literal: Exhausting Heaven spreading cosmos, exhausting earth opening feng—martial called all-conquering, civil displayed timely harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Exhausting Heaven and earth—martial all-conquering, civil harmony.

sentences.zh: 高宗稽古，德施周溥，茫茫九夷，削平一鼓。

translations.literal: Gaozong examined antiquity, virtue spread broadly—vast nine barbarians, leveled with one drum.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong examined antiquity—nine barbarians leveled with one drum.

sentences.zh: 禮備封禪，功齊舜禹，岩巍岱宗，衛我神主。

translations.literal: Rites complete feng-shan, merit equal Shun and Yu—lofty Dai Peak guards my spirit lord.
translations.idiomatic: Rites complete feng-shan, merit equal Shun-Yu—Dai guards spirit lord.

sentences.zh: 中宗紹運，舊邦惟新，睿宗繼明，天下歸仁。

translations.literal: Zhongzong continued fortune, old state only new; Ruizong continued brightness, all under Heaven returned to benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong continued fortune; Ruizong brightness—Heaven returned benevolence.

sentences.zh: 恭己南面，氤氳化淳，告成之禮，留諸後人。

translations.literal: Respectfully facing south, dense transformation pure—announcing completion's rite left to later people.
translations.idiomatic: Facing south, transformation pure—completion left to later people.

sentences.zh: 緬餘小子，重基五聖，匪功伐高，匪德矜盛。

translations.literal: Recalling I young person, repeated foundation five sages—not merit boasting high, not virtue pride abundant.
translations.idiomatic: I young person, five sages' foundation—not boasting merit, not pride virtue.

sentences.zh: 欽若祀典，丕承永命，至誠動天，福我萬姓。

translations.literal: Reverent as sacrifice canon, greatly inherit eternal Mandate—utmost sincerity moves Heaven, fortune my myriad people.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent sacrifice, inherit Mandate—sincerity moves Heaven, fortune people.

sentences.zh: 古封太山，七十二君，或禪亭亭，或禪云云。

translations.literal: Ancient feng Mount Tai—seventy-two lords; some shaned Tingting, some shaned Yunyun.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient feng Tai—seventy-two lords; some Tingting, some Yunyun.

sentences.zh: 其跡不見，其名可聞，祗遹文祖，光昭舊勳。

translations.literal: Traces not seen, names can be heard—respectfully following literary ancestor, glory illuminating old merit.
translations.idiomatic: Traces unseen, names heard—following literary ancestor, old merit bright.

sentences.zh: 方士虛誕，儒書不足，佚後求仙，誣神檢玉。

translations.literal: Fangshi empty absurd, Confucian books insufficient—lost posterity seeking immortals, deceiving spirits inspecting jade.
translations.idiomatic: Fangshi absurd, books insufficient—posterity sought immortals, deceived spirits inspecting jade.

sentences.zh: 秦災風雨，漢汙編錄，德未合天，或承之辱。

translations.literal: Qin disaster wind-rain, Han defiled compiled records—virtue not united Heaven, or inherited shame.
translations.idiomatic: Qin disaster, Han defiled records—virtue not Heaven, inherited shame.

sentences.zh: 道在觀政，名非從欲，銘心絕岩，播告群嶽。

translations.literal: Way in observing government, name not from desire—inscribe heart on cliff, broadcast announcing all peaks.
translations.idiomatic: Way in observing government, not from desire—inscribe cliff, announce all peaks.

sentences.zh: 於是中書令張說撰《封祀壇頌》、侍中源乾曜撰《社首壇頌》、禮部尚書蘇頲撰《朝覲壇頌》以紀德。

translations.literal: Thereupon Central Secretariat Director Zhang Yue composed Eulogy of Feng-Sacrifice Altar, Attendant-in-ordinary Yuan Qianyao composed Eulogy of Sheshou Altar, Rites Minister Su Ting composed Eulogy of Grand Audience Altar to record virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue composed Feng-Sacrifice Altar Eulogy, Yuan Qianyao Sheshou Altar, Su Ting Grand Audience Altar.

sentences.zh: 玄宗乙酉歲生，以華嶽當本命。

translations.literal: Xuanzong born yiyou year—with Mount Hua as natal mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong born yiyou—with Mount Hua as natal mountain.

sentences.zh: 先天二年七月正位，八月癸丑，封華岳神為金天王。

translations.literal: Second year of Xiantian seventh month took position; eighth month guichou fenged Mount Hua spirit as Golden Heaven King.
translations.idiomatic: Xiantian 2 month 7 took position; month 8 guichou fenged Hua spirit Golden Heaven King.

sentences.zh: 開元十年，因幸東都，又于華嶽祠前立碑，高五十餘尺。

translations.literal: Tenth year of Kaiyuan, visiting eastern capital, also erected stele before Mount Hua shrine, over fifty chi high.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 10 visiting eastern capital—steles before Hua shrine, fifty chi high.

sentences.zh: 又于岳上置道士觀，修功德。

translations.literal: Also on peak established Daoist abbey, cultivating merit.
translations.idiomatic: Also peak Daoist abbey, cultivating merit.

sentences.zh: 至天寶九載，又將封禪于華岳，命御史大夫王鉷開鑿險路以設壇場，會祠堂災而止。

translations.literal: By the ninth year of Tianbao, again would feng-shan at Mount Hua; ordered Censor-in-chief Wang Hong to open perilous roads and set altar fields—meeting shrine fire, halted.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbao 9 again would feng-shan at Hua; Wang Hong opened roads—shrine fire halted.
